about: Daily COMMENT is a multi-line box: Return makes a new line, like the iPhone. Which Return does what, and how many lines fit — the same vectors for the Mac (SpiraldayKit MultilineReturn · DailyForm.commentFits, Tests/SpiraldayKitTests/CommentReturnTests.swift), iOS (same Kit) and Windows · Android (web). Owner report 2026-10-08: on the Mac, Return in COMMENT ended writing instead of breaking the line. Tasks and MEMO keep Return = next row (1.0.5).

conventions.mods: shift · alt (Mac ⌥) · ctrl (Mac ⌃) · meta (Mac ⌘, Windows Win). Return, Shift+Return and the keypad Enter behave the same.
conventions.expect: newline = put a line break at the caret (replacing the selection) and keep writing; refuse = no line break, keep writing (Mac beep, iOS · Android haptic); end = finish writing
conventions.fits: whether the text with the line break added still fits the box at the smallest letters (see box)
conventions.composing: Return while composing Hangul commits the syllable once and then follows the same rule (Mac catches the key first and commits; Windows lets the IME commit and acts on the Enter it sends again)

box.about: design units. Letters shrink to fit (fitScale) down to minScale; at the smallest size maxLines lines fit. A text ending in a line break counts the empty line after it (the caret's line).

capacity.name: 5 lines ending in a line break → 6
a selection replaced by the line break
a long line wraps to 2 lines at the smallest letters: 2 + 2 → 5
